texts.preamble: K.Muthukumar vs The Executive Officer on 17 July, 2025 Author: C.Saravanan Bench: C.Saravanan Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 17.07.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice C.Saravanan W.P(MD)No.19288 of 2025 and W.M.P(MD)Nos.14805 and 14806 of 2025 K.Muthukumar Vs. The Executive Officer, Aralvoimozhi Town Panchayat, Kanyakumari District. Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorari, calling for the record pertaining to the impugned Notice issued by the respondent in Na.Ka.No.374/2025/A2 dated 27.06.2025 and quash the same as illegal, arbitrary, unconstitutional and unsustainable. For Petitioner : Mr.T.Selvan
texts.facts: The petitioner challenges the impugned communication issued by the respondent directing the petitioner to remove the poultry farm/shop run by the petitioner in his house, based on the complaint received by the respondent from the neighbours. 2. The petitioner admits that he has neither obtained any premission from the respondent before starting the aforesaid business nor has obtained any licence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.arguments: 3. The learned Additional Government Pleader for the respondent submits that the presence of the farm is causing nuisance to the neighbours and therefore, in view of the complaints received from the neighbours, the respondent had issued the impugned communication. 4. The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the central Government is promoting rearing of poultry under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Scheme and that the petitioner does not require any further license or permission . https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
